text:
maria: quick one — i'm prototyping the console affordance for automatic fallbacks. main goals: make it obvious WHY a route degraded, let an operator act (pin/revert/snooze), and surface audit detail without overwhelming. any red flags?

devin: +1. propose a compact reason pill + details panel. e.g. 'Triggered: error_rate (5m)'. panel contains timeline + sample telemetry + action buttons.

jonah: operator controls need to be conservative. suggest: 'pin primary' (prevent fallback) and 'force degrade' (manual). both should require a short form reason. full audit entry created for both.

sara: don't show raw stack traces in the UI — users will panic. high-level reasons only, with a "view raw" gated behind role perms. also :thumbsup: to required reason.

lia: telemetry we should include in the details panel: snapshot id, example prompt (anonymized), token counts, latency p50/p95 delta, cost estimate delta. also link to playback for 1 sample.

maria: UX mock: route header shows banner when degraded: [Degraded] pill + short reason. click expands into a two-column details view: left = timeline + triggers, right = sampled requests + actions (revert / schedule revert / snooze).

devin: example fallback policy JSON to back the UI (draft):
```json
{
  "id": "policy-7",
  "triggers": [
    {"type": "error_rate", "window": "5m", "threshold": 0.1},
    {"type": "latency", "window": "2m", "threshold_ms": 1200},
    {"type": "quality_regression", "window": "10m", "threshold": 0.05}
  ],
  "action": {"degrade_to": "small-quantized", "min_duration": "10m", "cooldown": "5m"}
}
```

jonah: how do we prevent oscillation? UX should show cooldown + next-eligible time. backend needs hysteresis: require stability before switching back. show predicted impact if we revert now.

sara: billing/quotas note: fallbacks may change token billing. show an "estimated cost delta" badge in the panel so PMs/ops don't get surprised.

lia: audit retention: default 30 days; enterprise toggle to 365 days. allow CSV export and an API endpoint for forensic exports. compliance will like that.

ops-bot: Policy update recorded — user devops@redwood updated policy policy-7; canary rollout started (canary: 5% traffic).

maria: security question — are we ok including anonymized sample prompts in the audit view? @security team to advise.

jonah: pragmatic approach: store full samples in encrypted archive, UI displays only hashed/anonymized snippet and token counts. export process can require approvals.

sara: final asks for the mock: make revert a two-step action (confirm + reason), default to "schedule revert" (5m) to avoid accidental flip-flops.

maria: agreed. schedule revert default + 5m confirmation. if scheduled revert fails, auto page on-call and show last-fallback-snapshot. i'll update the figma — dropping the link here: https://www.figma.com/file/XXXXX/fallback-affordance-proto

devin: nit — show "last triggered at" timestamp in the banner and offer a quick jump to the trace.

lia: also add an "explainability" button that surfaces the top 3 signals that contributed to the decision (weighted). useful for debugging.

maria: perfect. i'll iterate and post updated screens. thanks all :thumbsup:
